reusable_lessons.lesson: Compute denial rates using adjudicated_claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted) as the denominator, explicitly excluding Pended claims. Record both numerator and denominator with their definitions to ensure statistical accuracy and meet the golden standard.
Key monthly volume trends on service_date_from (when care began) rather than adjudication_date (when claims were processed), as adjudication dates lag service and introduce temporal inconsistencies.
Display every calculated rate in reports as 'numerator / denominator = rate' format to ensure statistical transparency and meet reproducibility requirements for stakeholder review.
